data.title: PayPal crypto strategy expands as PYUSDx goes live with $100M
data.description:
Businesses are now launching tokens that are backed by PYUSD to their customers, allowing PayPal to branch out of its standard PayPal Digital Dollar currency.

PYUSDX moved into public launch with projects such as Saturn, Concrete, and Pay Cap, making use of the platform, and MoonPay claims it has now reached a $100 million AUM upon launch day, due to these projects.

PYUSD becomes the foundation for other tokens

PYUSDx enables firms to issue stablecoins and attach to the currency their names, rules, and use, and they are backed by PYUSD, which is designed to remain at $1.

By offering this level of control without requiring them to build out the underlying payment and reserve system, companies would be able to issue their own tokenized dollars, backed by PYUSD-based rails, rather than relying on building out their own system. 

PayPal first announced PYUSDx with MoonPay and M0 in February, and its September launch means that it has now entered public use with companies.

Saturn uses the infrastructure for USDat, Concrete has launched concUSD for its investment services, while Cap has moved part of its cUSD system onto the platform.

They mainly target lending, investments, and other onchain financial services instead of everyday retail payments.

PYUSDx comes with an important distinction

Even with the PayPal branding, PYUSDx is still run by MoonPay Digital Assets, and it makes use of technology from M0.

Tokens that are created through the platform are issued by MoonPay Digital Assets, not by PayPal or Paxos [the company behind PYUSD].

The stablecoin cannot also be held, sent, or received from PayPal and Venmo accounts at this time due to regulations. But these regulations depend on the company, token, and country, so availability may differ.

PYUSD is still central, as it is the asset backing these bespoke tokens, and this means that increased use of PYUSDx might lead to increased demand for PYUSD without every customer needing to hold PYUSD.

The platform supports Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Monad, while built-in conversion tools allow participants to change tokens without each project having to create a new liquidity pool.

Final Summary

  • PYUSDx has entered public use with $100 million in reported assets under management.
  • MoonPay issues the customized tokens with PayPal’s PYUSD as the backing.

data.title: Solana expands tokenized equities as SOL tests $102.50 – Can it break higher?
data.description:
As trading activity grows to rival major venues, Solana’s tokenized equity markets are starting to attract attention.

In light of this, tokenized stocks on Solana [SOL] generated more than $200 million in volume. Surprisingly, these volumes exceed those associated with tokenized equities listed at both NASDAQ and NYSE, in excess of $100 million.

Notably, Raydium [RAY] captured about 70% of that activity, as such, representing the primary source of liquidity behind the growth. The comparison is narrower than it first appears. This is because it covers tokenized equities rather than the full stock market.

However, even with such a narrow scope, the size of the increase reflects the rapid pace of the emergence of on-chain stock trading. As more tokenized equities gain liquidity, Solana could become increasingly important for this emerging market.

Solana expands its tokenized-equity market

Against that backdrop, Solana’s tokenized-equity market is also expanding rapidly. As a result, this expansion gives traders a growing pool of assets to trade. Tokenized-equity supply reached a record $684 million last week, marking a 47% increase in just three weeks.

Increased amounts of capital are being represented through tokenized equities and ETFs as well. The expansion also comes from several issuers rather than one platform. xStocks, Ondo, Backpack Securities, Sunrise, Superstate, and Securitize have all launched stock products on Solana.

In total, these platforms offer over 100 different types of tokenized equities and ETFs, widening the market beyond a handful of assets.

This may create conditions that will allow for increased trading volume. However, there still needs to be substantial increases in trading volumes relative to new supply coming into the market.

SOL tests the $102.50 barrier

Meanwhile, Solana continues trading in a wide consolidation after its sharp August rally. The current price is currently near the midpoint of this trading range at approximately $101.48.

SOL trades near $101.48 after recovering from the $97.50 area, where buyers recently stepped in. That lower boundary (purple line) provided support at each of the previous two rallies, hence remaining the key support beneath price.

This lower boundary, shown by the purple line, has repeatedly protected the range and remains the key support beneath the price. Above it is a key resistance at $102.50 (orange line) that has acted as the main pivot, rejecting several advances since late August.

A sustained break above it would signal that buyers are finally overcoming repeated resistance and could expose the upper $107.50 level, marked by the purple line, followed by $110.68.

Meanwhile, the teal zone around $74–$78 shows the base that preceded August’s rally. RSI at 49.46 suggests momentum has reset, leaving SOL positioned for a decisive move.

Final Summary

  • Solana expands tokenized equities as volume tops $200 million and supply hits $684 million.
  • SOL is testing $102.50 after recovering from $97.50 and needs to break higher to extend its rally.

data.title: ETH/BTC ratio up 25% in Q3 – Ethereum eyes strongest quarter on record
data.description:
Is Ethereum’s outperformance in Q3 because of Bitcoin’s weakness? Judging from the rotation standpoint, yes.

According to Bitcoin’s quarterly framework, the dominant asset’s dominance grew by 1.5% on a quarterly basis so far, while Ethereum’s dominance is up by over 25% on a quarter-over-quarter basis.

This implies that there has been a significant rotation into ETH and higher beta assets in general as BTC approached the $80k resistance.

Further supporting this trend, the ETH/BTC ratio is also up by over 25% in Q3, which is its highest quarterly increase since Q3 2025. However, the ratio remains in the 0.03 resistance area, which suggests that the next move higher is needed to indicate a stronger bullish rotation into Ethereum.

And it seems highly plausible, considering Bitcoin’s on-chain dynamics.

According to Bitcoin’s True Market Mean Price, BTC is gradually approaching $76,921.27. And if it reaches this level, another wave of selling pressure is to be expected, which will unlock fresh deposits on exchanges and provide the required space for capital rotation into Ethereum [ETH].

In the given context, the analyst’s prediction makes perfect sense.

Especially, one analyst expects no less than Ethereum to outperform Bitcoin once the market flips risk-on driven by on-chain and technical factors.

This raises an important question: With ETH already leading Q3 with 58%+ ROI, is this growing FOMO setting the stage for Ethereum’s most bullish Q3 in crypto history?

Ethereum’s rising dominance points to a strong Q3 close

Ethereum’s growing dominance could be a sign that it is gaining more market share.

On the technical side, ETH.D is up over 25% on the quarter, on par with the increase of the ETH/BTC ratio. That being said, Ethereum’s Q3 ROI is at nearly 60%, just a few points shy of its Q3 2025 record of over 66%. If ETH breaks that level this quarter, it would mark its strongest Q3 on record.

This is where the chart below comes in. ETH.D is up over 25%, while ETH’s Q3 ROI is nearing 60%. This implies that ETH’s rise is being driven not only by the weakness of Bitcoin but also by an increased appetite for the altcoin itself, with the chart below being a powerful indicator of the trend.

In this scenario, the analyst’s forecast appears to be justified.

As rotational flows account for only a part of Ethereum’s Q3 proceeds, the underlying demand for ETH remains strong. Recent ETF inflows also support this setup, while Bitcoin’s weakness could give Ethereum more room to attract fresh capital as investors look for higher returns.

Final Summary

data.title: Cardano price holds $0.20 – But THIS level could decide ADA’s recovery
data.description:
Cardano [ADA] has rallied 2.42% in the past 24 hours, with an Open Interest increase of 2.5% in a day as of writing. The altcoin is up 17.7% over the past month.

The steady gains came alongside a Bitcoin [BTC] rally above $80k. However, while BTC has fallen back below $80k, the Cardano price continued to hold on to the $0.20 support zone.

Across different timeframes, ADA showed both bullish and bearish signs. The past month’s momentum was impressive, but investors need to look out for some warnings.

Cardano price prediction: Recovery hinges on this zone

The Cardano price has climbed above the 20-week Moving Average at $0.198 and flipped it to support for now. Yet, it was still below the $0.26-$0.28 area that is a key overhead supply zone.

Specifically, the $0.2887 swing high from May needs to be breached to allow ADA investors to believe in a long-term uptrend. The rally since June, though bullish, might still falter.

The CMF agrees with this idea, with a reading of -0.10 to signal capital outflows from ADA markets on the weekly timeframe.

Should ADA traders look to take profits?

The swing structure broke bullishly in June, when the latest lower high of the trend (back then, at $0.1849) was breached. The uptrend has kept going since then, with the Cardano price still on the bullish side of the 50-day moving average.

Yet, over the past two weeks, the altcoin has not managed to set a new high above $0.258.

At the same time, the $0.26-$0.28 supply zone from May was a key obstacle for the bulls to overcome. If they accomplish this, it would be a strong sign of recovery.

Until then, swing traders can maintain a bullish bias. A price move toward $0.26 can be used to take profits. Meanwhile, a drop below the $0.20 area would be a warning sign of a bearish shift.

If the $0.28 area is flipped to support, the next long-term buy opportunity could arise.

Final Summary

  • Cardano has strong bullish momentum in recent weeks.
  • This momentum has run into a pivotal supply zone, and capital inflows have slowed over the past week, according to the CMF.

data.title: Ethereum price eyes $3,000 as supply tightens – Can ETH break out?
data.description:
Ethereum [ETH] is currently in a period of consolidation after a strong rally. This rally pushed the altcoin to an eight-month high of $2,660. Since then, Ethereum has pulled back and has been trading around $2,474 as of writing. At this level, buyers are continuing to defend higher lows for Ethereum.

This has created a tightening triangle, with rising support meeting resistance near the recent highs, reflecting a balance between bulls defending lower prices and bears preventing further increases.

The shape of this triangle looks similar to an earlier triangle that had formed  before a 30.91% increase, adding credibility to the possibility of another large upside.

Notably, before the consolidation, whales accumulated Ethereum as more than $300 million worth of ETH left the exchanges.

That reduced available exchange supply and helped support the advance toward $2,660. Now, ETH needs to break the triangle’s upper boundary to revive that momentum. A breakout could target $3,000, while failure at support would expose $2,380–$2,400.

Ethereum’s liquid supply keeps tightening

Ethereum’s tighter liquid supply is adding further weight to its current price consolidation at approximately $2,474. The exchange balance has decreased to a range of 14.7 million ETH, as compared to earlier highs exceeding 20 million.

Moreover, the consistent flow of net outflow indicates that users are moving their ETH off exchanges, reducing available ETH for sale. Approximately 43 million ETH remains locked up in staking services, which represents nearly 35% of the total supply.

That share has continued to rise through 2026. In turn, this further limits readily tradable coins. Additionally, spot Ethereum ETFs represent yet another source of funds being absorbed by regulated entities.

As such, recent inflows have resulted in increased amounts of ETH being placed into regulated custody.

Collectively, these flow streams are resulting in a steady reduction in ETH’s liquid float while new issuances continue to be limited. Yet ETH still needs sustained demand to turn this supply pressure into another sustained rally.

Ethereum’s breakout faces a momentum test

Ethereum’s current setup lacks the momentum confirmation that fueled its previous breakout. The earlier triangle preceded a 30.91% rally in just three days, with volume expanding as ETH cleared resistance.

Currently the most recent consolidation indicates that volume on both sides of the trade has eased while price continues to stay around $2,510. ETH is approximately 5.6% under its last price of $2,660, which was the highest point reached in this rally. As a result, there is no evidence of buyers reclaiming the rally’s top.

Meanwhile, a rise in volume and an increase in open interest will indicate new participants entering the market and increase the probability of continuing the trend.

A sustained break higher could revive the $2,650–$2,700 zone, while weakening momentum would keep the recent high out of reach.

Final Summary

  • Ethereum [ETH] is consolidating near $2,474 as tightening liquid supply supports the bullish structure.
  • ETH needs stronger volume and open interest to confirm a breakout toward $2,650–$2,700 and potentially $3,000.

data.title: IRS issues ‘roughly 10,000 letters per month’ for crypto audit – Trump allegedly exempt
data.description:
The U.S. federal government’s Internal Revenue Service (IRS) has come up with a crypto tax audit system. According to Clinton Donnelly, an expert in U.S. crypto tax law and IRS audits, warning letters are being sent to people whom the agency believes may have engaged in cryptocurrency transactions. 

So for those unaware, there are three different types of letters being issued by the IRS. This includes Letter 6173, Letter 6174, and Letter 6174-A. Interestingly, none among the three are identical, and receiving one does not necessarily mean that a taxpayer is being formally audited. 

All about the three different letters from the IRS

Letter 6174 is generally the least serious of the three and serves mainly as a compliance notice. Receiving it does not automatically mean an audit, but taxpayers should review their returns and correct any errors if necessary.

Letter 6174-A is similar but provides more detailed and direct guidance on crypto tax obligations. However, Letter 6173 is more serious because it requires taxpayers to sign a statement under penalties of perjury confirming their compliance or explaining their tax treatment. 

Donnelly believes, 

They [IRS] may be issuing roughly 10,000 letters per month and have been doing so for about a two years straight now.

Is the IRS favoring Donald Trump?

Now, while on one hand, the IRS is sending letters to common taxpayers. On the other hand, the Citizens for Responsibility and Ethics in Washington (CREW) has filed an amicus brief against the IRS on the 9th of September.

In the brief, they have argued that there is an alleged arrangement involving President Donald Trump, the IRS, and Treasury officials that is protecting Trump, his family, and affiliated businesses from certain tax audits.

This, according to CREW, violates the Constitution’s ‘Domestic Emoluments Clause.’ 

That said, the lawsuit centers on a $1.776 billion “anti-weaponization fund” and an alleged IRS immunity order that CREW, including the National Treasury Employees Union (NTEU), says could give President Trump, his family, and affiliated businesses special protection from tax enforcement. 

The argument is particularly significant because tax audits were reportedly underway when the immunity order was signed. And CREW cites allegations that Trump could have faced more than $100 million in additional taxes related to claimed Chicago property losses.

Other countries and their tax rules

This comes on the heels of the UAE’s Federal Tax Authority introducing a new 2026 framework for handling cryptocurrency payments under VAT, requiring businesses to convert digital-currency transactions into UAE dirhams (AED) for reporting.

At the same time, France’s rising crypto kidnapping risk has been partly linked to concerns over tax-related data security. Earlier this year, Telegram founder Pavel Durov alleged that French tax officials were selling personal data to criminal groups, contributing to crypto kidnappings.

Final Summary

  • The IRS sends different types of letters, which include Letter 6173, Letter 6174, and Letter 6174-A for the common taxpayers.
  • But the arrangement with President Trump and his family is raising eyebrows.

data.title: Filecoin breaks $1 as volume explodes – Can bulls sustain FIL’s rally?
data.description:
Filecoin [FIL] broke out of a month-long range, pushing the altcoin above $1 for the first time since May. At the press time, FIL’s price surged by 20.1%, up to $0.9685, when it went over the $0.87 resistance, which previously blocked attempts to create a rally.

The surge was short-lived but pushed the price up to $1.03 before falling back down to around the $0.97 mark. The 24-hour trading volume also skyrocketed by 1026% alongside the price rally, up to $396.66 million.

This indicates that participation was up significantly during this time frame.

However, RSI stood at 78.05, which indicated an overbought territory. The resulting pullback from $1.03 towards $0.90 may be due to some early sellers locking in their profits.

That leaves $0.87 as the key level for the breakout. Holding above it would show buyers have absorbed the old resistance and could support another move toward $1.03. Losing it would weaken that demand and raise the risk of FIL falling back into its previous range.

Can network growth support FIL?

Filecoin’s breakout is further evidence of the way traders are starting to view Filecoin’s fundamentals.

A recent Solstice proposal may have added some credence to this new trend by focusing on one of Filecoin’s most publicized issues. This has been the bottleneck associated with the approval process for DataCaps.

The Solstice upgrade would tie block reward payments directly to verified transactional payments. Therefore, this implies that there would be a direct relationship between FIL’s economic model and real-world network utilization.

However, current FVM activity remains modest, with about 1,337 daily active addresses and DeFi TVL standing at $3.1 million.

This suggests the rally is pricing in future growth rather than strong usage today. Solstice strengthens that outlook, but rising network activity will be needed to sustain FIL’s breakout.

FIL’s rally puts $1 in focus

FIL’s breakout is now testing the psychological $1 level after the price reached $1.0299 before pulling back to $0.9685. The move has attracted fresh derivatives positioning, with open interest rising toward $284 million around the advance.

Futures volume also ran about 10 times higher than spot activity, showing that leverage is playing a major role in the push. That strength could help FIL clear $1, but it also raises the risk of sharper swings if traders begin taking profits.

Meanwhile, the former $0.87 ceiling has already held as support once, making it the key level beneath the rally. Holding $0.87 would keep the breakout structure intact and leave $1 within reach.

A sustained break above $1 could extend momentum, while losing $0.87 would weaken the move.

Final Summary

  • Filecoin broke above $0.87 as volume surged 1,026% as the price pushed past $1.
  • FIL needs to hold $0.87 and sustain demand for the breakout to continue.

data.title: Bitcoin defends $76K as sellers dominate – Could BTC stage another reversal?
data.description:
On the 11th of September, Bitcoin [BTC] fell to a low of $76,046. Just an hour and a half later, BTC had rallied 5.05% to reach a high of $79,890. This kind of swift, intense volatility hunted down both long and short liquidations.

The seemingly resurgent bulls were stopped in their tracks. Over the weekend, BTC consolidated between $76.5k and $77.5k. In recent trading hours, Bitcoin once again breached the upper boundary, but it is unclear if it will fall lower once again.

The upcoming week could see more BTC volatility

The Federal Reserve and the Bank of Japan are about to provide back-to-back policy decisions, making this week a pivotal one for markets. There is an 85% probability of a rate hike, and the markets have likely priced it in.

A 1.25% BOJ increase is expected, too. The real question is how hawkish both central banks sound after the decision, wrote XWIN Japan on CryptoQuant.

A rise in U.S. yields and yen appreciation would be particularly risky for Bitcoin. Such tight liquidity conditions could lead to investors cutting risk in crypto.

Will the fearful market conditions see another BTC reversal?

The 30-day sum of the Funding Rates on Binance was aggregated this way to make spotting a trend easier. The bearish consensus earlier this year saw some of the most bearish derivatives sentiment on Binance. Yet, the rally in May that reached $82,850 used this build-up of short positions as fuel.

Analyst Darkfost wrote that this kind of bearish consensus has tended to mark the end of a Bitcoin correction. In the months since then, Funding Rates have recovered from extreme bearishness.

The build-up of optimism has to be accompanied by steady spot demand to drive the next bull run.

Well-known analyst Joao Wedson used the monthly CVD chart of Bitcoin to understand buy and sell pressure on a monthly basis and how BTC prices react to it. The metric resets every month. At the time of writing, September was seller-dominated. However, it does not automatically yield a bearish bias.

If BTC manages to hold on to key supports, such as $76k, while the monthly CVD is deeply negative, it would mean passive (limit order) buys have absorbed the aggressive selling.

Final Summary

  • Bitcoin is likely to have a volatile trading week ahead, even though the market has priced in an 86.5% rate hike chance.
  • The derivatives and monthly CVD data highlighted how Bitcoin optimism has been building since May, but strong buying pressure has to come in to keep the recovery alive.

data.title: Revolut hack escalates as attackers threaten ‘more and more data’ leaks
data.description:
The phishing attack on Revolut, which happened two days ago, has taken another unexpected turn.

According to International Cyber Digest’s recent findings, the attacker has now revealed sensitive information of high-profile clients, including tennis player Shevchenko and Gamdom CEO Felix Romer.

Moreover, the attacker is now trying to use the information obtained through that process as leverage to force Revolut to pay money.

We’re gonna start releasing more and more data everyday until Revolut pays for leaking their customers.

How is the attack getting serious day by day?

Needless to say, the incident has escalated from a data breach into an extortion campaign. The attackers are reportedly publishing customer passports and selfies while threatening to release more information unless they are paid.

However, naming specific individuals does not prove they were affected. Threat actors often mix genuine data with fabricated claims, outdated information, or details taken from other sources.

In fact, even Revolut itself has not yet confirmed the identity of the attacker, the new ransom demand, the claimed high-profile victims, or the authenticity of the newly leaked material.

The way out

With Revolut serving around 80 million customers across 30 countries, the potential impact is significant. However, as an immediate safety step,

Revolut immediately blocked the address across all internal systems, initiated notifications to relevant regulators, and applied precautionary protection measures for affected customers.

All in all, the for customers, the biggest concern is that exposed KYC and transaction information can enable highly targeted social engineering.

And that’s where technologies such as zero-knowledge proofs are more helpful. They help reduce future exposure by allowing institutions to verify information without collecting or sharing unnecessary personal data.

Final Summary

  • The incident has gone far beyond a data breach and has now turned into an extortion campaign.
  • Revolut serves around 80 million customers across 30 countries; hence, the impact can be multifold.

data.title: Lighter surges 11% as whale scoops up $2M LIT: Is $5 still on the cards?
data.description:
It seems like Lighter [LIT] has reached its bottom. After declining for five consecutive days, Lighter is seeing a trend reversal and falling  to a low of $4.00.

Now, the upside is getting a fresh push. For that reason, LIT surged 11%, jumping back to $4.68 before retracing to $4.55 as of this writing.

The altcoin’s upside push was backed by a 52% surge in trading volume, with the volume reaching $75 million.

With the volume rising, turnover also made a strong upside move, rising to $37 million, a marking over a $9 million jump. This suggested strong buying pressure.

Lighter saw renewed demand amid growing social chatter over the CLARITY Act. For example, analyst Andy noted that Lighter is loving the CLARITY recent developments since Vlad is in the CFTC innovation advisory committee.

The market sees his regulatory involvement as advantageous for Lighter amid the likelihood of clearer rules for digital assets.

Lighter sees renewed interest from both whales and retail traders

As the altcoin signaled a trend reversal, Lighter saw  renewed demand from both whales and small-scale investors. For starters, some whales have rushed to take position, despite the ongoing upside.

According to Arkham data, an address withdrew 500,000 LIT from the Lighter protocol worth $2.07 million. With the whale scooping up amid these gains, it reflects optimism, as they anticipate there is more room for growth.

On top of that, traders have also returned to speculate. Altcoin’s Open Interest surged 13% to $512 million, while the volume for derivatives jumped 127%.

The rise in OI backed by strong volume, suggesting that traders aggressively opened new positions. A look at the Long/Short Ratio, it seems these investors mostly went long, with Binance traders leading with a ratio of 2.8.

Can the uptrend hold?

With the uptick, LIT flipped both the 9- and 21-day moving averages, reflecting short-term upside pressure.

At the same time, the Stochastic RSI formed a bullish crossover and jumped to 9. With the crossover, it suggests that buyers have started to outpace sellers.

However, at 9, the indicator warns that buyers have yet to fully retake the market. But the upward trajectory reflects changing power dynamics.

Therefore, if the demand holds, the uptrend will continue and reclaim $5. For this bullish outlook to hold, LIT must close above its short-term MA around $4.4.

Final Summary 

  • LIT saw a trend reversal, surging 11%, to a local high of $4.68, then slightly retraced to $4.50. 
  • A whale purchased $2.07 million in LIT amid renewed market interest over the likelihood of CLARITY passing in the US Senate.
